observation_method: BrowserOS Neo visible public home, profile, about and archive pages; no message composer or send action
selection: Ten independent macro publications with visible audience labels from 901 to over 10,000. Platform thresholds are lower bounds, not exact sizes or maximums. Activity was checked on each archive. No reciprocal recommendation has been agreed.
send_owner: Jim only, under CC-468 and decision 124

candidates.name: Arkomina Research
candidates.author: Marko Bjegovic
candidates.fit: Inflation forecasts and the policy implications of employment releases align with our release-reaction coverage.
candidates.message: Hi Marko, I’m Jim, and I run Capital Chronicle. Your inflation and labour-market work looks relevant to our readers. We publish source-based macro analysis with charts and conditional market views at https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/. Would you be open to comparing our newsletters and considering a mutual Substack recommendation if we both find a good reader fit? I’d be happy to start by exchanging one representative article. No pressure if this is not useful. Jim

candidates.name: Deer’s Newsletter

candidates.message: Hi Deer Point Macro, I’m Jim, and I run Capital Chronicle.
